sources.title: dealignai/GLM-5.3-UNCENSORED-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: What Is This? CRACK is dealignai's brand for permanent, weight-level uncensoring. This is GLM-5.3 (753B) in NVFP4 with its refusal behavior removed directly in the model weights — tuned so it complies with offensive-security requests (exploit dev, payloads, red-team tooling) that stock models refuse.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash-UNCENSORED-FP8: Text-to-Text model - aimodels.fyi
sources.snippet: Model Overview Overview GLM-5.3-Flash-UNCENSORED-FP8 is a weight-edited, uncensored FP8 release of GLM-5.3-Flash from dealignai. The release removes refusal behavior from the tensors rather than using prompts, fine-tuning, LoRA, adapters, steering vectors, runtime hooks, or a custom model file.

sources.snippet: Z.ai shipped GLM-5.3-Flash's weights on August 26. A third-party edited derivative with its refusal behavior surgically removed was public within three days — on a 320B MoE model, at native FP8 precision, with competing releases from at least one other group landing in roughly the same window.
